title: RBI Officer Grade B Phase-I Admit Card 2026 for 60 Post
intro: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has Released Official Notification for Online Application form for the Post of Officer Grade B (DR)- General, DEPR, DSIM Recruitment 2026 for 60 Post. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to RBI Jobs. Exam Held On June 13, 2026 & Admit Card Released On June 5, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Admit Card Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: Online Apply Start On: 29 April 2026
Last Date for Registration: 20 May 2026 (06:00 PM)
Last Date for Pay Exam Fee: 20 May 2026
Phase I Admit Card: 05 June 2026
Phase I Exam Date: 13 June 2026 (DR General)
Phase I Exam Date: 14 June 2026 (DEPR/ DSIM)
Phase II Exam Date: 25 July 2026 (DR General)
Phase II Exam Date: 26 July 2026 (DEPR/ DSIM)
General / OBC/ EWS  : Rs. 850/-
SC/ ST/ PH Candidates  : Rs. 100/-
Payment Mode:  Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card Net Banking Fee Mode
Minimum Age: 21 Years
Maximum Age: 30 Years
For Age Relaxation.Read the Official Notification.
Age Calculator:  Click Here

Graduation Level: Graduation in any discipline (or equivalent technical/professional qualification) with at least 60% marks (50% for SC/ST/PwBD).
																			➔ Minimum 3 years duration from a recognized University/Institute.

Post-Graduation Level: Post-Graduation in any discipline (or equivalent technical/professional qualification) with at least 55% marks (pass marks for SC/ST/PwBD).
																			➔ Minimum 2 years duration from a recognized University/Institute.
Both levels require government-recognized qualifications for eligibility.

Master's Degree in Economics / Econometrics / Quantitative Economics / Mathematical Economics / Integrated Economics Course/ Finance, with a minimum of 55% marks (50% in case of SC/ST/PWD) or an equivalent grade in aggregate of all semesters /years from a Recognized Indian or Foreign University /Institute.

Master's Degree in Statistics/ Mathematical Statistics/ Mathematical Economics/ Econometrics / Statistics & Informatics from IIT-Kharagpur/ Applied Statistics  & Informatics from IIT-Bombay with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent grade.
For More Details See Official Notification
